notes.subject: go be go le
notes.rationale: Seheberu ga se na kopula; Sepedi e e nyaka

notes.subject: 430 mengwaga
notes.rationale: Genesi 15:13 e bolela mengwaga ye 400; mo 430 — baphetoleli ba phapantšha go akaretša nako ya Kanaane gbona

notes.subject: mengwaga ye masometharo le ye makgolo a mane le lesome
notes.rationale: palo ya mengwaga ya go dula

notes.subject: go dula
notes.rationale: מושב ke 'boemo/bohlalo'; diphuthelwana tše ngwadišago di bolela 'sojourning' — nako ya go nna, e sego go nna ka lerato

translation: Gomme go dula ga bana ba Yisraele, bao ba dulago Mitsrayime, go be go le mengwaga ye masometharo le ye makgolo a mane le lesome.
